data.body: Operator decision D-DRV-Q1 (option C now). Keep small. Third-party drivers register through Python entry points or as external executables speaking a versioned JSON protocol over stdio (the Lane interface from DRV-lane-interface plus descriptor/fact data). Registration is operator-only (never from a project layer or cloned repo). Each plugin carries a trust label and runs under a declared sandbox (no ambient secrets, env by name only). The conformance suite of DRV-conformance runs against any plugin before it is enabled. Replaces the design-note-only part of DRV-packs. Test: an unregistered plugin never loads; a project layer cannot register one; a plugin failing conformance is refused; unknown protocol version is refused.
data.title: Plugin SDK for third-party drivers: entry points or external executables speaking a JSON protocol, operator-only registration, sandbox and trust labels
